tools.description: Invoke a project endpoint through the viat-api project router (/p/{slug}/...). Returns status, headers, body, and a truncated flag (body capped at 1 MiB).

method.description: HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, ...).

path.description: Endpoint path within the project, e.g. "/users/123". Must start with '/'.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

timeout_ms.description: Request timeout in milliseconds (default 10000, capped at 60000).

tools.name: call_endpoint

tools.description: Create an endpoint node: a leaf with exactly ONE binding — script_name, workflow_name, proxy_resource_name (+proxy_strip_prefix/proxy_upstreams), crud_resource_name (+crud_config), or ws_config — or, with NO binding and NO method, a directory node other nodes hang under (build /api/users as directory 'api' + child 'users'). `tree` takes a tree NAME and is required once the project has several trees. Editor-gated.

crud_resource_name.description:
Bind a table-CRUD leaf to a `postgresql` resource (needs
`crud_config` + `method`).

method.description:
HTTP method; required for script/workflow/crud leaves, absent for
directories and proxy mounts.

parent_id.description: Parent node id; omit to create at the tree root.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

proxy_resource_name.description: Bind a proxy mount to an `http_api` resource.

proxy_strip_prefix.description: Strip the mount's own prefix before forwarding (default true).

proxy_upstreams.description: Per-path-param upstream overrides for the mount (value → resource).

segment.description: Path segment (a literal like `users`, or a `:param` placeholder).

tree.description:
Tree NAME. Omitted works only while the project has exactly one
tree (the server then picks it); required once there are several.

A websocket endpoint cannot be called with call_endpoint.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

owner_type.description: Filter by the owning object (what `set_resource`/scripts recorded).

status_min.description: Min HTTP status to include (inclusive). E.g. 500 to see only errors.

count.description: How many fires to list (default 5, capped 20).

cron.description: The cron expression to check (5 fields).

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: preview_cron

tools.description: Publish the project as one atomic snapshot revision. ALWAYS call publish_plan first. A 409 (publish_warnings_unacknowledged / publish_test_failures) carries the warning list in its message — read it, fix the cause or consciously accept it, and only then resend with acknowledge_warnings / acknowledge_test_failures. NEVER blind-ack. Publisher-gated (project Owner/Admin).

acknowledge_test_failures.description:
Accept known-failing test-case gates after reading them in the
409's message. Defaults false.

acknowledge_warnings.description:
Accept the plan's WARNINGS (legacy nodes on reserved paths etc.)
after reading them in the 409's message. Defaults false.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: publish_apply

tools.description: What a publish would ship right now, with a one-line diff_summary per endpoint. Read this BEFORE publish_apply — it is the safety surface for the apply.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: publish_plan

tools.description: Roll the project back to the revision before the latest publish (nothing to roll back → 400). A script's `# uses:` modules are read live and are NOT rolled back. Publisher-gated.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: publish_rollback

tools.description: One async run's state — the poll target for a detached test-run (run_id from test_run_script with run_async) or an X-Viat-Async endpoint call started from the console. Terminal states carry the output.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

run_id.description: The run_id a detached test-run or `X-Viat-Async` call returned.

tools.name: read_async_run

tools.description: Read the project's control-plane audit trail (who changed which scripts/endpoints/settings, when). Publisher-gated (project Owner/Admin). The audit of your own tables is a different surface: call_endpoint on /_audit/{resource}.

actor.description: Filter by actor (user email or system principal).

before.description:
Keyset cursor: pass BOTH `before` and `before_id` from a prior
page's `next_before` / `next_before_id`.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

since.description: Only entries at or after this RFC3339 timestamp.

tools.name: read_audit

tools.description: Fetch one execution by request_id and its line_logs (capped). Returns execution summary + lines + truncation indicator.

line_limit.description: Max log lines to return (default 500, capped at 2000).

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.description: The most recent 50 messages a queue trigger consumed, with the execution each became. Editor-gated.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

before.description:
RFC3339 timestamp cursor for paging. The response is a bare array
with no next-page marker — to page, pass the oldest row's
`started_at`.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: read_schedule_runs

folder.description:
Folder path; omit for the project root. Pass this when the bare name
exists in more than one folder — the API refuses an ambiguous name
with 409 and names the folders.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.description: Fetch one workflow's YAML definition.

folder.description: Folder path; omit for the project root.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

Deliberately does NOT create/update triggers — a stock deployment refuses creation without ack_deadline_override (timeout ceiling 1800s > ack deadline 1500s) and needs an amqp resource first; configure from the console. Editor-gated.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: set_queue_trigger_enabled

tools.description: FIRE the rule's channel once with a test payload — this REALLY SENDS to the webhook/chat/email/push destination, not a dry run. Returns delivered plus the error when it bounced. For push, delivered means provider acceptance, NOT confirmed handset receipt. Publisher-gated.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: test_alert

tools.description: Run a script's LIVE DRAFT as a test — no publish needed, no endpoint auth (runs as the platform; Editor-gated). The edit→test→publish loop's test step. A failing script is a successful tool result with ok:false and an `error` object, NOT an isError. Set run_async for long runs and poll the returned run_id with read_async_run. Async success/failure also triggers a best-effort notification to the initiating user's registered project devices, without output or error details.

args.description: The script's input (what `main` receives). Defaults to `{}`.

folder.description: Folder path; omit for the project root.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

record.description:
Record the run's resource calls and return them per resource
(sync runs only).

run_async.description:
Detach: answer immediately with a `run_id` to poll via
`read_async_run`, instead of holding the call for the run's length.

timeout_ms.description:
How long to wait for a synchronous run, in milliseconds
(default 30000, clamped to 1000..60000).

tools.name: test_run_script

tools.description: Fire a schedule NOW, out of band from its cadence — the response's request_id is what read_logs takes for the run's output. 409 when a run is already active or its queue is busy/full. Member-gated.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.description: Change which authorizers/gates guard an endpoint node: pass authz_gates to declare them here, inherit_authz_gates:true to go back to inheriting, or neither to leave untouched — omitted fields are re-sent as their current values, so they survive the update. Editor-gated.

allowed_authorizers.description: Authorizers allowed at this node (replaces the inherited list).

authz_gates.description: Authz-model gates to declare here (`[{type, action}]`).

inherit_authz_gates.description:
Clear this node's gates and inherit from the parent instead —
mutually exclusive with `authz_gates`.

override_authorizers.description: Make this node's authorizer list THE list (stop inheriting).

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.description: Change what a node IS — segment, method, script/workflow binding, overrides, ws/crud config, path_override. Only passed fields are sent; the server's null-clears-field behaviour is not exposed here (clear from the console). Editor-gated.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

script_name.description: Rebind the leaf to another script.

workflow_name.description: Rebind the leaf to another workflow.

tools.name: update_endpoint_info

tools.description: Create or update an alert rule by name. kind: endpoint_errors (needs window_secs >= 60) | schedule_failures (must NOT be windowed). channel_kind: webhook | chat | email | push. Exactly ONE matching destination: webhook_url | email_to (needs SMTP) | chat_account+chat_id | push_resource (existing project push resource name or qualified path). Publisher-gated (Owner/Admin).

chat_id.description: Chat id (group/user the message goes to) — for `chat`.

email_to.description: Comma-separated recipient list — for `email` (needs SMTP configured).

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

push_resource.description: Existing project push resource name or qualified path — for `push`.

threshold.description: How many failures inside the window trip the rule (≥ 1).

webhook_url.description: The URL POSTed on fire — for `webhook`.

tools.name: upsert_alert

tools.description: Create or replace a schedule by name — replacement is WHOLESALE: every field you pass (plus the defaults) is what the schedule becomes. Trigger: trigger_kind cron (+cron/timezone) | interval (+every_secs 10..86400) | once (+at, within 10 years). Target: target_kind script (+target_script) | workflow (+target_workflow) | endpoint (+target_method/target_path, must be PUBLISHED). Member-gated.

at.description: When to fire once, RFC3339 within 10 years — for `once`.

catch_up.description: Fire for occurrences missed while the server was down.

inputs.description: Input object handed to every run.

name.description: Schedule name (its identity; upserts by it).

on_overlap.description:
`skip` | `queue` | `parallel` — what a fire does while the previous
run is still going (default `skip`).

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: upsert_schedule

tools.description: Parse-and-validate a workflow YAML definition without saving anything. Check a definition here before writing it; an invalid one is rejected at write time with the same code. Editor-gated (Owner/Admin/Developer).

definition.description: The workflow YAML definition to check.

name.description:
Workflow name (the route requires the path segment; the definition
being validated is what matters).

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: validate_workflow

tools.description: Create or update one script (an existing name+folder is updated with only the fields you pass; a new one needs language + content). The response's pending_endpoints names bound endpoints whose published snapshot is now stale — the change stays invisible to callers until you run publish_plan then publish_apply. This tool never moves a script between folders. Editor-gated (Owner/Admin/Developer).

content.description: The script body — required when creating; on update, the new source.

dedicated.description: Run on dedicated worker slot(s) instead of the shared pool.

folder.description:
Folder path naming where the script lives — omit for the project
root. Locates the script (create target / update lookup); this tool
never moves a script between folders.

language.description:
Language (`python`, `typescript`, …) — required when creating;
fixed for the script's life thereafter.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: write_script

tools.description: Create or update a workflow by name — the definition is required both ways (update replaces it wholesale; validate_workflow checks one first). pending_endpoints names bindings a publish is owed. Editor-gated.

definition.description:
The workflow YAML definition — validated at write; check it first
with validate_workflow. Required for both create and update.

folder.description: Folder path; omit for the project root.

project.description: Project slug; falls back to default_project at the call site.

tools.name: write_workflow
